articles.title: IMF Mission Set to Visit Argentina for Third Program Review
articles.description: The International Monetary Fund will commence a mission in Argentina the week of September 21 for a third program review. The focus will be on rebuilding reserves, reducing financing risks, and preserving the fiscal anchor to ensure economic stability.
articles.content:
The International Monetary Fund (IMF) announced on Thursday that it plans to start a new mission in Argentina during the week of September 21. The mission is part of the IMF's third review of the country's existing program.

articles.title: Argentina's youth debt crisis grows as living costs outpace jobs

articles.title: The Messi economy: Life after Argentina is still big money for the 'Little Magician'
articles.description: Lionel Messi's brand value grows as his football career nears its end. His global recognition and consistent excellence attract major international brands. His move to Inter Miami significantly boosted Major League Soccer's commercial appeal. Messi's established narrative provides brands with a ready-made story to share. His cultural memory ensures his brand's longevity beyond his playing days.
